title: calochlaena straminea
intro: Calochlaena straminea, commonly known as the stramineous fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Australian Aboriginal medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of colds, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Calochlaena straminea include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and other polyphenolic compounds, although further research is needed to confirm the extent of its bioactive properties.
